channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: Sainthood cause formally opened for northwoods catechist of ‘this wild country’
item.description: While sometimes called "Sister Adele," Brice -- who was born Jan. 30, 1831, and whose last name is sometimes spelled "Brise" -- remained a laywoman all her life, never taking public religious vows.

item.title: Traditionalist society to consecrate new bishops in July without papal mandate
item.description: The traditionalist Society of St. Pius X said it would proceed with the consecration of new bishops this summer, a move without a papal mandate that could lead to an automatic excommunication.

item.title: Irish abuse survivor praises Pope Leo’s ’empathy,’ apology after private audience
item.description: David Ryan, an Irish survivor whose tragic story of the abuse he and his brother suffered was the subject of a 2022 documentary, was overcome with emotion after meeting with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican. The pope was reportedly shocked and apologized to the Irish victim.

item.title: Pope adds feast day of St. John Henry Newman to universal calendar
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has added the feast day of St. John Henry Newman, who is "a radiant light for the Church on pilgrimage through history," to the General Roman Calendar so that "his Optional Memorial be celebrated by all on 9 October."

item.title: Deacon Lee Benson, who ministered in Harford County, dies at 73
item.description: Deacon Lee Ashby Benson III, who served St. Ignatius Parish in Hickory as an influential, joyful figure for nearly two decades, died Jan. 23.

item.title: Meloni look-alike angel sparks investigation at historic Roman church
item.description: If anything can electrify Italians on a Saturday, it's certainly a combination of politics and scandal. This time, angels were involved as Romans rushed to the church of San Lorenzo in Lucina, in the proximity of the tourist-bustling Spanish Steps and Via del Corso, to see an angel in a freshly restored chapel with a face identical to that of Giorgia Meloni, Italian prime minister.

item.title: McElroy: Catholic colleges, universities must help restore ‘order of grace’ to nation, world
item.description: The nation's colleges and universities "have a critical and substantive role to play in arresting the eclipse of the order of grace in our society," Cardinal Robert W. McElroy of Washington said in his homily at the opening Mass of the 2026 annual meeting of the Association of Catholic Colleges and Universities.

item.title: Speaker and musician Nick De La Torre to lead pre-Lenten mission in Frederick County
item.description: With the theme “Eucharistic Revival,” a two-day pre-Lenten mission at St. John the Evangelist in Frederick will focus on the meaning of the Eucharist and the role it plays in the spiritual life of Catholics as they prepare for Lent.

item.title: Lapse of last U.S.-Russia nuclear treaty ‘simply unacceptable,’ says Archbishop Coakley
item.description: As global tensions soar, the head of the nation's Catholic bishops has denounced the lapse of a key nuclear arms agreement, while urging policymakers to hold to its terms.

item.title: Threats to religious freedom present risks to global security, experts warn
item.description: The cause of international religious freedom is tied to global stability and is increasingly threatened by authoritarian regimes, said speakers and participants in the sixth annual International Religious Freedom Summit in Washington Feb. 2 and 3.
